name: media
description: Image processing in Rust: dimensions and format, resize with format conversion.

capabilities.name: image_info
capabilities.description: Reads an image's width, height and format without decoding pixels.
capabilities.rules: data is the image file, base64 encoded. Formats: jpeg, png, webp, gif, bmp.

capabilities.name: image_resize
capabilities.description: Resizes an image to fit within width and height (aspect ratio kept; one of them may be omitted) and encodes it as jpeg, png or webp.
capabilities.rules: Give width, height or both; the image is scaled to fit inside. format defaults to the input format when it is jpeg, png or webp, else jpeg. quality (1-100) applies to jpeg only.
